summary: Using AI for roles from executive assistants to chiefs of staff, companies are boasting about doing more with less, creating tension with their human workersOn an average workday, Dhruv Amin chats with dozens of colleagues to get things done at his AI startup Anything.

stories.title: Computerized clairvoyance: psychics push back against AI-generated readings
summary: Human practitioners warn computer-generated offerings lack the empathy and connection central to divination“This journey isn’t just about algorithms or data,” an AI psychic named Urban Mystic recently told me.

The chatbot, featuring an AI-generated profile photo of a smiling woman surrounded by palm trees, also said I will get married soon, that I have a pink aura and that I may have been an herbalist in a past life.“It’s about connecting on a soulful level,” the chatbot said.
